description: Canonical required facts consumed by the current TaskKernel quality/publication path.

semantics.baseline_commit: Git baseline commit verified in the producer repository
semantics.snapshot_tree: Optional immutable tree captured after full grill-with-docs writes; new official attempts always include it
semantics.decision_ref: Optional task-relative canonical decision receipt; requires decision_hash
semantics.decision_hash: SHA-256 of the exact decision receipt bytes
semantics.reviews: Direction and detail wh-review semantic result refs or provenance-bound unavailable attempt refs consumed by new official attempts

semantics.snapshot_tree: Current authenticated workspace tree used for this fact
semantics.source_digest: Current authenticated source-content digest used for this fact
semantics.review: Task-relative wh-review semantic result ref or provenance-bound unavailable attempt ref consumed by new official attempts

semantics.snapshot_tree: Current authenticated workspace tree used for this fact
semantics.source_digest: Current authenticated source-content digest used for this fact
semantics.review: Task-relative wh-review semantic result ref or provenance-bound unavailable attempt ref consumed by new official attempts

semantics.changed: List of changed artifacts from this stage
semantics.review: Task-relative wh-review semantic result ref or provenance-bound unavailable attempt ref plus its snapshot tree. Consumers must open the referenced record and must not trust a copied verdict.
semantics.phase_completion: Completion facts derived by the runtime from authenticated current tasks.md task states, evidence references, acceptance coverage, and final review; callers cannot assert completion
semantics.acceptance_coverage: Exactly one covered, missing, or unknown row for every accepted acceptance criterion, bound to the same snapshot as implementation, tests, and final review

semantics.tests: Fresh verification command and physical result facts
semantics.review: Formal wh-review semantic result reference or provenance-bound unavailable attempt reference
semantics.quality_note: Optional human-facing quality summary; not an automatic gate
